tailored_resume_bullets: Built a production-ready tours and travel management system using Angular, Node.js, Express, and MySQL during internship at Sunflower Trip, taking it live for real customer bookings.
Implemented role-based access control (RBAC) with secure authentication, separating admin and end-user workflows across the platform.
Designed an admin dashboard for managing bookings, users, and travel packages, streamlining day-to-day operations for the internal team.
Developed Zenvest, a full-stack MERN stock trading platform featuring JWT-based authentication using httpOnly cookies, Joi request validation, and proxy-integrated market data APIs.
Built StaySphere, an Airbnb-style property rental platform using Node.js, Express, MongoDB, and Passport.js authentication with session-based login and ownership-based authorization.
kit.cover_letter: Dear Hiring Manager, I am writing to apply for the MERN Developer - Intern position at Nxtwave Disruptive Technologies. As an MCA student at PES University with practical full-stack experience in the MERN stack, I am eager to contribute to your engineering team. During my internship at Sunflower Trip, I built a production-ready tours and travel management system using Node.js, Express, and Angular, which went live for real customer bookings. I implemented role-based access control and designed admin dashboards to streamline operations. Additionally, I built Zenvest, a full-stack trading platform clone using the MERN stack, JWT-based authentication, and Joi request validation, as well as StaySphere, an Airbnb-style rental platform utilizing Node.js, Express, and MongoDB with Passport.js authentication. These projects demonstrate my ability to build secure, functional full-stack web applications from the ground up. I am available for the 6-month internship in Bangalore and look forward to the potential full-time opportunity following the internship. Thank you for considering my application. Sincerely, Amaanuddin Ahmed
